fullText.simplified:
江东之主

    几天以后，孙策醒了。
    他的脸没有好，头还是很疼。
    医生说他要好好休息，不能着急，不能生气，不能担心，不能……
    孙策很生气，这也不能做，那也不能做，像个病人一样，从早睡到晚，这还是他孙策吗？他还有很多事情要做，怎么能休息？
    孙策没有听医生的话，还和以前一样，每天工作到很晚。他睡得少，起得早，早上醒来，喝口水就又开始努力工作。他很着急，想快点儿打败刘表，快点儿打到北方去……但是，事情和孙策想的不太一样。刘表的军队好像变厉害了，他的军队总是打不过去。北方厉害的人也越来越多，还有人总是说他的坏话。
    听到那些坏话，孙策很生气，他越来越生气。
    三个月后，孙策的身体越来越不好，后来，他不能起床了。
    最后，孙策终于明白了，爸爸没有做完的事，他也做不完了。他的时间不多了，他快要死了。
    家人和助手们站在床边，每个人都很难过，大家都在哭。虽然孙策也很难过，但是他没有哭。和爸爸死的时候一样，他把难过放在了心里。
    他只看着一个人，这个人是他的弟弟，叫孙权。
    他看了很长时间，然后笑了。他对孙权说：“弟弟，你过来。”
    孙权哭着走过去，他哭得太厉害，说不出话。
    孙策拉着他的手，说：“不要哭，也不要难过。我死以后，江东的主人就是你了，你要记着爸爸和我的努力，好好保护江东，让江东的明天更好。”
    孙权还是说不出话，他哭得更大声了。
    孙策说完这些话又睡着了，这一次，他没有再醒过来，他醒不来了。
    孙策死了。这一年，他二十七岁。
fullText.traditional:
江東之主

    幾天以後，孫策醒了。
    他的臉沒有好，頭還是很疼。
    醫生說他要好好休息，不能著急，不能生氣，不能擔心，不能……
    孫策很生氣，這也不能做，那也不能做，像個病人一樣，從早睡到晚，這還是他孫策嗎？他還有很多事情要做，怎麼能休息？
    孫策沒有聽醫生的話，還和以前一樣，每天工作到很晚。他睡得少，起得早，早上醒來，喝口水就又開始努力工作。他很著急，想快點兒打敗劉表，快點兒打到北方去……但是，事情和孫策想的不太一樣。劉表的軍隊好像變厲害了，他的軍隊總是打不過去。北方厲害的人也越來越多，還有人總是說他的壞話。
    聽到那些壞話，孫策很生氣，他越來越生氣。
    三個月後，孫策的身體越來越不好，後來，他不能起床了。
    最後，孫策終於明白了，爸爸沒有做完的事，他也做不完了。他的時間不多了，他快要死了。
    家人和助手們站在床邊，每個人都很難過，大家都在哭。雖然孫策也很難過，但是他沒有哭。和爸爸死的時候一樣，他把難過放在了心裡。
    他只看著一個人，這個人是他的弟弟，叫孫權。
    他看了很長時間，然後笑了。他對孫權說：“弟弟，你過來。”
    孫權哭著走過去，他哭得太厲害，說不出話。
    孫策拉著他的手，說：“不要哭，也不要難過。我死以後，江東的主人就是你了，你要記著爸爸和我的努力，好好保護江東，讓江東的明天更好。”
    孫權還是說不出話，他哭得更大聲了。
    孫策說完這些話又睡著了，這一次，他沒有再醒過來，他醒不來了。
    孫策死了。這一年，他二十七歲。

sentences.traditional: 幾天以後，孫策醒了。
sentences.pinyin: jǐ tiān yǐ hòu sūn cè xǐng le
sentences.english: Several days later, Sun Ce woke up.

sentences.simplified: 他的脸没有好，头还是很疼。
sentences.traditional: 他的臉沒有好，頭還是很疼。
sentences.pinyin: tā de liǎn méi yǒu hǎo tóu hái shì hěn téng
sentences.english: His face was not healed yet, and his head hurt a lot.

sentences.simplified: 医生说他要好好休息，不能着急，不能生气，不能担心，不能……
sentences.traditional: 醫生說他要好好休息，不能著急，不能生氣，不能擔心，不能……
sentences.pinyin: yī shēng shuō tā yào hǎo hǎo xiū xi bù néng zháo jí bù néng shēng qì bù néng dān xīn bù néng
sentences.english: The doctor said he needed to rest well. He must not be anxious, must not get angry, must not worry, must not ...

sentences.simplified: 孙策很生气，这也不能做，那也不能做，
sentences.traditional: 孫策很生氣，這也不能做，那也不能做，
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè hěn shēng qì zhè yě bù néng zuò nà yě bù néng zuò
sentences.english: Sun Ce was very angry. He couldn’t do anything.

sentences.simplified: 像个病人一样，从早睡到晚，这还是他孙策吗？
sentences.traditional: 像個病人一樣，從早睡到晚，這還是他孫策嗎？
sentences.pinyin: xiàng ge bìng rén yí yàng cóng zǎo shuì dào wǎn zhè hái shì tā sūn cè ma
sentences.english: He felt like a sick person, sleeping from morning until night. Was this still the real Sun Ce?

sentences.simplified: 他还有很多事情要做，怎么能休息？
sentences.traditional: 他還有很多事情要做，怎麼能休息？
sentences.pinyin: tā hái yǒu hěn duō shì qing yào zuò zěn me néng xiū xi
sentences.english: There was still so much to do. How could he rest?

sentences.simplified: 孙策没有听医生的话，还和以前一样，每天工作到很晚。
sentences.traditional: 孫策沒有聽醫生的話，還和以前一樣，每天工作到很晚。
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè méi yǒu tīng yī shēng de huà hái hé yǐ qián yí yàng měi tiān gōng zuò dào hěn wǎn
sentences.english: Sun Ce did not listen to the doctor. Every day he worked until it was very late, just like he did before.

sentences.simplified: 他睡得少，起得早，
sentences.traditional: 他睡得少，起得早，
sentences.pinyin: tā shuì de shǎo qǐ de zǎo
sentences.english: He slept very little and woke up very early.

sentences.simplified: 早上醒来，喝口水就又开始努力工作。
sentences.traditional: 早上醒來，喝口水就又開始努力工作。
sentences.pinyin: zǎo shang xǐng lái hē kǒu shuǐ jiù yòu kāi shǐ nǔ lì gōng zuò
sentences.english: When he woke up in the morning, he would take a sip of water and then immediately begin working hard.

sentences.simplified: 他很着急，想快点儿打败刘表，快点儿打到北方去……
sentences.traditional: 他很著急，想快點兒打敗劉表，快點兒打到北方去……
sentences.pinyin: tā hěn zháo jí xiǎng kuài diǎn'r dǎ bài liú biǎo kuài diǎn'r dǎ dào běi fāng qù
sentences.english: He was very anxious. He wanted to quickly defeat Liu Biao and quickly fight his way north ...

sentences.simplified: 但是，事情和孙策想的不太一样。
sentences.traditional: 但是，事情和孫策想的不太一樣。
sentences.pinyin: dàn shì shì qing hé sūn cè xiǎng de bú tài yí yàng
sentences.english: But, things were not quite as Sun Ce thought.

sentences.simplified: 刘表的军队好像变厉害了，他的军队总是打不过去。
sentences.traditional: 劉表的軍隊好像變厲害了，他的軍隊總是打不過去。
sentences.pinyin: liú biǎo de jūn duì hǎo xiàng biàn lì hai le tā de jūn duì zǒng shì dǎ bú guò qu
sentences.english: It seemed that Liu Bao’s troops had become more formidable, and his troops were never able to fight their way over.

sentences.simplified: 北方厉害的人也越来越多，还有人总是说他的坏话。
sentences.traditional: 北方厲害的人也越來越多，還有人總是說他的壞話。
sentences.pinyin: běi fāng lì hai de rén yě yuè lái yuè duō hái yǒu rén zǒng shì shuō tā de huài huà
sentences.english: There were more and more powerful people in the north, and there were always people saying bad things about him.

sentences.simplified: 听到那些坏话，孙策很生气，他越来越生气。
sentences.traditional: 聽到那些壞話，孫策很生氣，他越來越生氣。
sentences.pinyin: tīng dào nà xiē huài huà sūn cè hěn shēng qì tā yuè lái yuè shēng qì
sentences.english: Hearing these bad things being said about him, Sun Ce was very angry. He became more and more angry.

sentences.simplified: 三个月后，孙策的身体越来越不好，后来，他不能起床了。
sentences.traditional: 三個月後，孫策的身體越來越不好，後來，他不能起床了。
sentences.pinyin: sān ge yuè hòu sūn cè de shēn tǐ yuè lái yuè bù hǎo hòu lái tā bù néng qǐ chuáng le
sentences.english: Three months later, Sun Ce’s health was getting worse and worse. Later, he could no longer get out of bed.

sentences.simplified: 最后，孙策终于明白了，爸爸没有做完的事，他也做不完了。
sentences.traditional: 最後，孫策終於明白了，爸爸沒有做完的事，他也做不完了。
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu sūn cè zhōng yú míng bai le bà ba méi yǒu zuò wán de shì tā yě zuò bù wán le
sentences.english: In the end, Sun Ce realized that what his father could not finish, he could not finish either.

sentences.simplified: 他的时间不多了，他快要死了。
sentences.traditional: 他的時間不多了，他快要死了。
sentences.pinyin: tā de shí jiān bù duō le tā kuài yào sǐ le
sentences.english: He did not have a lot of time left. He was going to die soon.

sentences.simplified: 家人和助手们站在床边，每个人都很难过，大家都在哭。
sentences.traditional: 家人和助手們站在床邊，每個人都很難過，大家都在哭。
sentences.pinyin: jiā rén hé zhù shǒu men zhàn zài chuáng biān měi ge rén dōu hěn nán guò dà jiā dōu zài kū
sentences.english: His family members and assistants stood next to his bed. Everyone was very sad, and everyone was crying.

sentences.simplified: 虽然孙策也很难过，但是他没有哭。和爸爸死的时候一样，他把难过放在了心里。
sentences.traditional: 雖然孫策也很難過，但是他沒有哭。和爸爸死的時候一樣，他把難過放在了心裡。
sentences.pinyin: suī rán sūn cè yě hěn nán guò dàn shì tā méi yǒu kū hé bà ba sǐ de shí hou yí yàng tā bǎ nán guò fàng zài le xīn lǐ
sentences.english: Even though Sun Ce was also very sad, he did not cry. Just like when his father passed away, he kept his sadness inside.

sentences.simplified: 他只看着一个人，这个人是他的弟弟，叫孙权。
sentences.traditional: 他只看著一個人，這個人是他的弟弟，叫孫權。
sentences.pinyin: tā zhǐ kàn zhe yí ge rén zhè ge rén shì tā de dì di jiào sūn quán
sentences.english: He only looked at one person. That person was his younger brother, Sun Quan.

sentences.simplified: 他看了很长时间，然后笑了。他对孙权说：“弟弟，你过来。”
sentences.traditional: 他看了很長時間，然後笑了。他對孫權說：“弟弟，你過來。”
sentences.pinyin: tā kàn le hěn cháng shí jiān rán hòu xiào le tā duì sūn quán shuō dì di nǐ guò lái
sentences.english: He looked at him for a long time and then smiled. He said to Sun Quan, “Younger brother, come over here.”

sentences.simplified: 孙权哭着走过去，他哭得太厉害，说不出话。
sentences.traditional: 孫權哭著走過去，他哭得太厲害，說不出話。
sentences.pinyin: sūn quán kū zhe zǒu guò qu tā kū de tài lì hai shuō bù chū huà
sentences.english: Sun Quan came over, crying so hard that he was unable to speak.

sentences.simplified: 孙策拉着他的手，说：“不要哭，也不要难过。
sentences.traditional: 孫策拉著他的手，說：“不要哭，也不要難過。
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè lā zhe tā de shǒu shuō bú yào kū yě bú yào nán guò
sentences.english: Sun Ce held his hand and said, “Don’t cry and don’t be sad.

sentences.simplified: 我死以后，江东的主人就是你了，你要记着爸爸和我的努力，
sentences.traditional: 我死以後，江東的主人就是你了，你要記著爸爸和我的努力，
sentences.pinyin: wǒ sǐ yǐ hòu jiāng dōng de zhǔ rén jiù shì nǐ le nǐ yào jì zhe bà ba hé wǒ de nǔ lì
sentences.english: After I die, you will be the master of Jiangdong. You must remember our father’s efforts and my efforts.

sentences.simplified: 好好保护江东，让江东的明天更好。”
sentences.traditional: 好好保護江東，讓江東的明天更好。”
sentences.pinyin: hǎo hǎo bǎo hù jiāng dōng ràng jiāng dōng de míng tiān gèng hǎo
sentences.english: Protect Jiangdong well and create a better future for Jiangdong.”

sentences.simplified: 孙权还是说不出话，他哭得更大声了。
sentences.traditional: 孫權還是說不出話，他哭得更大聲了。
sentences.pinyin: sūn quán hái shi shuō bù chū huà tā kū de gèng dà shēng le
sentences.english: Sun Quan still couldn’t speak, and he cried even more loudly.

sentences.simplified: 孙策说完这些话又睡着了，这一次，他没有再醒过来，他醒不来了。
sentences.traditional: 孫策說完這些話又睡著了，這一次，他沒有再醒過來，他醒不來了。
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè shuō wán zhè xiē huà yòu shuì zháo le zhè yí cì tā méi yǒu zài xǐng guò lái tā xǐng bù lái le
sentences.english: After Sun Ce said these words, he fell asleep again. This time, he did not wake up again. He could no longer wake up.

sentences.simplified: 孙策死了。这一年，他二十七岁。
sentences.traditional: 孫策死了。這一年，他二十七歲。
sentences.pinyin: sūn cè sǐ le zhè yì nián tā èr shí qī suì
sentences.english: Sun Ce was dead. That year, he was 27 years old.

sentence_translations: The Master of Jiangdong
Several days later, Sun Ce woke up.
His face was not healed yet, and his head hurt a lot.
The doctor said he needed to rest well. He must not be anxious, must not get angry, must not worry, must not ...
Sun Ce was very angry. He couldn’t do anything.
He felt like a sick person, sleeping from morning until night. Was this still the real Sun Ce?
There was still so much to do. How could he rest?
Sun Ce did not listen to the doctor. Every day he worked until it was very late, just like he did before.
He slept very little and woke up very early.
When he woke up in the morning, he would take a sip of water and then immediately begin working hard.
He was very anxious. He wanted to quickly defeat Liu Biao and quickly fight his way north ...
But, things were not quite as Sun Ce thought.
It seemed that Liu Bao’s troops had become more formidable, and his troops were never able to fight their way over.
There were more and more powerful people in the north, and there were always people saying bad things about him.
Hearing these bad things being said about him, Sun Ce was very angry. He became more and more angry.
Three months later, Sun Ce’s health was getting worse and worse. Later, he could no longer get out of bed.
In the end, Sun Ce realized that what his father could not finish, he could not finish either.
He did not have a lot of time left. He was going to die soon.
His family members and assistants stood next to his bed. Everyone was very sad, and everyone was crying.
Even though Sun Ce was also very sad, he did not cry. Just like when his father passed away, he kept his sadness inside.
He only looked at one person. That person was his younger brother, Sun Quan.
He looked at him for a long time and then smiled. He said to Sun Quan, “Younger brother, come over here.”
Sun Quan came over, crying so hard that he was unable to speak.
Sun Ce held his hand and said, “Don’t cry and don’t be sad.
After I die, you will be the master of Jiangdong. You must remember our father’s efforts and my efforts.
Protect Jiangdong well and create a better future for Jiangdong.”
Sun Quan still couldn’t speak, and he cried even more loudly.
After Sun Ce said these words, he fell asleep again. This time, he did not wake up again. He could no longer wake up.
Sun Ce was dead. That year, he was 27 years old.
